title: $p$-Kähler structures on fibrations and reductive Lie groups
summary: We investigate the existence of $p$-Kähler structures on two classes of complex manifolds: on quasi-regular fibrations, with particular emphasis on complex homogeneous spaces, and on reductive Lie groups endowed with invariant complex structures. In the latter setting, we construct non-regular complex structures on the Lie algebras $\mathfrak{sl}(2m-1,\mathbb{R})$ for $m \ge 2$ and show that these structures admit compatible balanced metrics, providing new explicit examples of balanced manifolds.
